name: SHORT-DESCRIPTION
data: Designed by Maurizio Manzoni, the Thomas double bed by Cattelan Italia evokes an anthropomorphic figure through its shell-like headboard, which juts out at the sides with curves and indentations to create clearly delineated contours. Soft upholstery softens its shape, enhanced by elegant patterning with wide stitching in a quilted effect. The raised bed frame is finished in fabric or leather to match the headboard and is supported by metal feet. A pleasing contrast is created between the rounded corners of the upholstery and the square shape of the metal feet, which feature a central slit. Available in sizes A, B, D, E and G, the bed is upholstered in fabric, micro nubuck, soft leather, soft leather glove or synthetic leather as per the sample card, with bronze or graphite embossed lacquered steel feet. Provided slats are part of the bed structure.
